info.name: QeSuite IFRS Financial Accounting API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the QeSuite IFRS Financial Accounting System.

## HOW TO USE
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default: http://localhost:8080)
2. Run Phase 00 first — every subsequent phase depends on IDs captured here
3. Each request captures its response IDs into collection variables automatically
4. Run phases in order: 00 → 01 → 02 → 03 → 04 → 05 → 06 → 07 → 08 → 09 → 10 → 11

## KEY FIXES IN THIS VERSION
- **JWT Security**: Untyped tokens now rejected; startup guard for insecure default secret
- **Journal Approval**: DRAFT → SUBMIT (06.02) → APPROVE (06.03). Direct DRAFT→POST blocked.
- **Reversal (IAS 8)**: Reversing entries posted in current open period, not closed period
- **IFRS 15**: OVER_TIME lines credit Deferred Revenue account (01.12a), not revenue immediately
- **Discounts**: Discount JE line added on approval — discounted invoices now balance correctly
- **FX Revaluation**: Liability direction now IAS 21 compliant; missing rates throw 404
- **Password Change**: Revokes all sessions; re-login required (11.04b)
- **Matched Amount**: Payment match stores matchedAmount; postPayment applies correct partial amount
- **Tenant Isolation**: UserController, ApiKeyController enforce entityId scoping
- **RBAC**: All journal/ledger/financial controllers now have @PreAuthorize role guards

## FULL ACCOUNTING WORKFLOW
Setup → COA → Periods → Parties → Assets → Journal → Revenue Cycle → Period-End → Financial Statements → Reports
